recodes.label: neither satisfied nor dissatisfied
recodes.evidence_quote: there’s been a general consensus on our course that the one female lecturer we’ve had is possible the worst role model we could’ve ever asked for and we prefer – we much prefer just having whoever.
recodes.reasoning: Strong criticism of one lecturer but implied preference for the others; no clear overall valence about lecture quality, so a mid/neutral satisfaction code is most defensible.
